env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

env CC=

env CGO_ENABLED=
[cgo] logos -C b run .
[cgo] stdout '^b: 42$'

env CGO_ENABLED=
[cgo] logos -C g run .
[cgo] stdout '^g: 42$'

env CGO_ENABLED=
[cgo] logos -C w run example.com/ma
[cgo] stdout '^ma: 42$'
[cgo] ! logos -C w run example.com/mb
[cgo] stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\] cgo is disabled'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/a

go 1.27

-- logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "forbid"

-- main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("a") }

-- b/go.mod --
module example.com/b

go 1.27

-- b/logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "allow"

-- b/main.lgo --
package main

/*
int answer() { return 42; }
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("b:", C.answer()) }

*/
import "C"

func main() { fmt.Println("g:", C.answer()) }
